problem: DataStorage finalization counted every record not claimed by a parsed modeler/surface callback as an orphan, including a record whose object handle exists in the validated DWG HANDLE map.

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.rule: The data-record header's Handle field is the handle of the object present in the data segment (PDF page 255).

physical_motivation.observation: One public AC1027 drawing contains an additional schema-0 thumbnail record at handle 0x22. Its bytes match the independent ODA DXF output, but it is not a parsed modeler entity.
physical_motivation.limit: The source observation identifies a valid non-modeler record, but the external DWG was not rerun with this diagnostic change. This receipt's new regression uses generated in-memory records and source-frame entries.

implementation.orphanRecordCount: Counts an unlinked record only when its handle has no matching validated source-frame ledger entry.
implementation.unboundRecordCount: Counts an unlinked record whose 32-bit handle indexes a source-frame ledger entry with the same handle.
implementation.diagnostic: datastorage-unbound-source-frame is informational and states that the source handle exists but no typed modeler/surface callback claimed the record.
implementation.staleIndex: A missing, out-of-range, or handle-mismatched source-frame index cannot suppress orphan accounting.
implementation.output: No writer routing, record preservation, graph-closure, or 3D semantic behavior is changed.
